world.title: Newborn twins fight for survival as conflict fuels Yemen's hunger crisis

world.description: The Brazilian president accuses the tech firm of favouring Flávio Bolsonaro, which it denies.

US.title: Actor Tom Skerritt, who played dads, cops and commanding officers, has died

US.title: Greetings from the Brazil-Argentina border, where waterfalls are flowing at near-record rates
US.description: The Iguazú Falls span more than a mile across both countries. A rain-soaked October, which scientists link to the Super El Niño, has sent near-record volumes of water surging over the towering cliffs.

US.title: Trump merchandise stores are closing: 'He has peaked'
US.description: At least four Trump merchandise stores have closed this year. Store owners say with Trump in his final term, there isn't as much to fire up his consumer fan base and sales have softened.

US.title: A GOP congressman voted to cut Medicaid. It covers 62% of his district. Can he win?
US.description: Republican U.S. Rep. David Valadao is fighting for reelection in central California. 6 in 10 residents of his district are covered by Medicaid, which he voted to cut last year.

US.title: Trump's redistricting gave Republicans a head start, now it goes to the voters
US.description: President Trump, seeking to reshape the voting map, prompted a rare wave of mid-decade redistricting that gave Republicans a boost for holding the House. But the voters will determine if it works.

US.title: How long does it take to save up for a starter home? Twice as long as it did in 2019
US.description: A new analysis finds that the average renter household now needs 16 years to save for a down payment and closing costs. Rising rents and other costs have consumed a growing share of household budgets.

US.title: See how Big Tech is transforming Spain's landscape
US.description: A drought-stricken region of northeast Spain has become a focus for American companies searching for locations to place their data centers.
